notes: S4 W3-E acceptance shots (pnpm qa --set s4-e): the EffectsSystem — Doom's plume, Barad-dûr / Isengard smoke, Black Gate smoke, waterfalls with spray and plunge foam (Rivendell, Rauros, Henneth Annûn), mist cards (Rivendell, Sirannon, Morgul vale), the Morgul beam (event morgul-beam), the beacons (event beacons) and Lake-town's chimney smoke. s4e-doom-fx and s4e-riv-fx are the mount-doom-close / rivendell-close bookmarks as JSON shots (pnpm shots --determinism repeats JSON shots only); s4e-doom-fx runs at tFx 37.25 (random access to a non-zero effect clock). Owned by the effects module.

shots.note: = mount-doom-close (S4 W5 orbit, lookOverride mordor, f/4; synced in S4.5) at tFx 37.25: the plume rises from the crater, bends downwind and spreads into the ash deck, lit red from below; crater sparks
= rivendell-close as a JSON shot: the falls (aerated white cores, translucent edges, plunge foam, spray), mist below the halls
Doom from 30 km: the ash column rising out of the crater, its lower third lit by the lava, bending downwind into the pall
night, events {morgul-beam: 1}: the Great Signal — a green beam from the tower crown up into the pall; the city lit green by its spill
the same frame without the event: no beam; the vale mist stays
night, events {beacons: 1}: the beacon on the crag burns — flames and a smoke column (= w2d-mt-beacons)
the Falls of Rauros from downstream: the wide curtain, plunge foam and the spray cloud rising from the foot
late afternoon: a few thin chimney smoke columns over the roofs, bending with the wind
